fadeRule: Wait 24 elapsed hours after application, then fade once at the first local 06:00 at or after that time. No further dimming.
limits: Fictional use-days at 06:00; growth and bright/faded levels remain illustrative.
Group-level latest-application preview; per-contribution evidence handling is not implemented.
Growth color exports use full-resolution visible material coordinates before antialias reduction; anchor calibration uses phone samples.
Anchors are calibrated once on visible material per form; no daily relocation.

orangeInspection.limits: Pixel thresholds are internal diagnostics; at-a-glance appearance requires developer review.
